description: Restore the Installed Pack Catalog and share optional read-Practice hints with subagents.

hooks.command: if output="$(lore hook codex)"; then printf '%s\n' "$output"; else printf '%s\n' '{"continue":true}'; fi
hooks.commandWindows: try { $output = & lore hook codex; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { $output } else { '{"continue":true}' } } catch { '{"continue":true}' }

hooks.command: if output="$(lore hook codex)" && [ "$output" != '{"continue":true}' ]; then printf '%s\n' "$output"; else printf '%s\n' '{}'; fi
hooks.commandWindows: try { $output = & lore hook codex; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0 -and $output -ne '{"continue":true}') { $output } else { '{}' } } catch { '{}' }
